name: Agent Context tab lists the project documents with the seeded attachments first
description: From /agents, open the seeded Security Reviewer and switch to ?tab=context. The server runs with PROJECT_DOCS_SOURCE=fixture (set by scripts/e2e.sh and e2e-web.yml), so the picker lists the 6 deterministic documents (specs, docs, insights, a root README.md and client/specs/ui-components.md) of acme/payments-api. The seed attaches 2 of them (specs/security-baseline.md, docs/architecture.md), so the header badge reads '2 of 6 attached', those two rows come first in DOM order, and the footer reads '2 files · N tokens total'. Read-only (no attach/detach clicks, no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api is the only repo and a server started with PROJECT_DOCS_SOURCE=fixture (see e2e/README.md).

steps.label: open the Context tab via the deep link
context tab is active in the URL

cmd: (() => { const p = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="context-doc-row"][data-path]')].map((r) => r.getAttribute('data-path')); return p[0] === 'specs/security-baseline.md' && p[1] === 'docs/architecture.md'; })()
steps.label: the 2 attached documents come first, in attach order
